A one-wave output-pair owner preserves total threads, all four original K partitions, scalar FMA order, wave trees, and partition-add order, yet removes LDS/barriers. rejected_q4_precursor.name: local128 four-wave private metadata broadcast
rejected_q4_precursor.reason: Raises logical VGPR 44 to 84 before timing; fixed-coefficient broadcast is not selected.

audited_not_selected.reason: Clang already emits one QH plus four QS byte loads per row/superblock; source hoisting is cosmetic and further sharing repeats rejected packing ownership.
A row-uniform rewrite becomes two VMEM loads, adds 9 instructions/32 bytes, and leaves logical VGPR75 unchanged; direct scale reads raise logical VGPR75 to 108 and add 143 instructions.
No-barrier repeated-exp is 51.24-51.46% slower, wave broadcast is about 16% slower, and packed 64-bit metadata is 22.1-22.6% slower; cached metadata is not the bottleneck.
The first no-LDS form raises logical BF16/F32 VGPR44 to 84; it is rejected before timing.

closed_before_selection: unchanged output packing, heterogeneous IQ2/Q5 ownership, grouped-query attention, and launch-count-only fusion
rerank_and_exclusion_audit.source: immutable retained post-local32 short/512/1024/3968 traces plus current repository ISA; no retained benchmark rerun

selection.arithmetic_contract: One wave owns adjacent output rows. Each lane reconstructs original local128 thread partitions lane+{0,32,64,96} in four independent accumulators per output, replays each partition's K and K+128 FMA order for every Q4_K superblock, applies the same five-stage wave tree, then adds partition totals in original 0,1,2,3 order before the same F32 store.
selection.candidate: exact Q4_K local32 fixed-address-metadata output-pair GEMV for c=1 BF16-to-F32 LM head
difference_from_closed_mechanisms: No reduction reassociation: the four original local128 K partitions remain independent until the same ordered final add.
No wave/work contraction: total threads and physical wave count are unchanged, unlike rejected head/workgroup packing.
No activation quantization, dp4a, output packing, weight repack, sidecar, graph, packet, or launch-count change.
The selected Q5 fixed-metadata precedent is transferred to Q4 output pairs; this is not the rejected Q4 eight-row wave-private coefficient-broadcast form.

geometry.unchanged: total threads, total physical waves, one final F32 value per vocabulary row, and one kernel dispatch

implementation_plan: Add a sibling local32 fixed-metadata helper/kernel/export; do not alter the retained local128 kernel or existing wrappers.
Add one rows=1 BF16-to-F32 Python wrapper and separately registered gfx1100 four-axis key; explicitly exclude the key from gfx1151 aliases.
Do not add a runtime selector/capability until primitive, codegen, actual-weight, and cached symbol/resource gates pass.
If admitted, select the exact key only at Laguna's root lm_head through session/backend capability state, never through a quant/backend branch in engine or model dispatch.
selection.metadata_contract: For each of two output rows and each 256-K block, read uniform d/dmin plus the same three packed 32-bit scale/min words, decode the same eight six-bit scale/min pairs at fixed compile-time subblocks, and read the unchanged raw 4-bit payload. No repack or sidecar is introduced.
selection.scope: Only rows=1 raw-Q4_K BF16-to-F32 Laguna LM-head selection. Existing local128 pack8 variants remain exact fallbacks for BF16/BF16, FP16/FP16, FP16/F32, rows>1, registry miss, rollback, and unsupported backends.

findings: HIP mmvq consumes Q4_K through q8_1 vector-dot machinery; its RDNA3 nwarps=1 path does not provide this exact BF16/F32 partition-preserving sibling.
Vulkan mul_mat_vecq uses packed 32-bit raw-Q4 loads and dotPacked4x8EXT; that accuracy/schedule is not transplanted into this exact candidate.
The candidate is an in-tree specialization based on retained Q5 fixed-address metadata and is not a source port.
